body:
Username: InspirAsian135

Reason: Anti-kb (it says there's a video)

Why I should be unbanned: I've never even hacked before, and i think this is one big misunderstanding. I've never been banned before, or been caught ban-evading. This is my first time appealing a ban. I think this ban was false, since lately, we've been having internet issues, and it might have been lag. Also, it says that there's a video, and I think it's not fair that I don't even get to see it. This account is new, and we just switched accounts from TheCreeperFace08. I really like to play on Avicus, and I don't see any reason to hack on there.
